claims.hypothesis: The B-type companion can be located directly relative to V838 Mon
claims.experiment: ALMA 25-mas continuum imaging and Gaussian fits
claims.result: Component B at 38.2 mas (225.4 au) from component M
claims.finding: Component B traces material around the B companion; separation close to ~250 au estimate, orbit near sky plane

evidence.quote: We identify the component as material directly surrounding the B-type companion of V838 Mon and call it hereafter the “B component”.

claims.hypothesis: An elongated dusty disk/torus surrounds the merger product
claims.experiment: Gaussian fit to component M and RADMC-3D modeling compared to SED and images
claims.result: 17.6x7.6 mas source; inclined hollow disk model (26°, 95 au) fits better than spherical cloud
claims.finding: Component M is most likely a torus-like structure at moderate inclination, though not firm

evidence.quote: Although this interpretation is not firm, as our data lack the angular resolution to be definitive, such a structure is expected to exist around merged systems.

claims.hypothesis: The B star interacts with the merger ejecta, deflecting it and altering its chemistry
claims.experiment: Moment maps of CO, SiO, SO, AlOH, SO2+H2S; Shape SiO model; analytic BHL and radiation-pressure estimates
claims.result: NW region most redshifted and turbulent (~30 km/s excess dispersion), SiO void cone, enhanced SO2/H2S and AlOH
claims.finding: B star gravity and radiation create turbulent wake and cone; shocks alter composition

evidence.quote: The B-type star not only deflects the merger ejecta but also changes its chemical composition with an involvement of circumstellar shocks.

claims.hypothesis: Mass of the remnant can be constrained
claims.experiment: Revised LTE line analysis and RADMC-3D dust model
claims.finding: Molecular and dust masses estimated; atomic mass unconstrained

evidence.quote: The remnant’s molecular mass is about 0.1 M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ and the dust mass is 8.3$\cdot$10$^{-3}$ M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$. The mass of the atomic component remains unconstrained.

limitations_admitted.value: Dust model parameters not uniquely constrained; exploratory

limitations_admitted.value: Only one transition per species; no temperature gradients from line ratios

limitations_admitted.value: Dust opacity is the largest SED uncertainty

evidence.quote: The biggest uncertainty in the SED reconstruction comes from dust opacities as a function of wavelength and location in the remnant.

limitations_admitted.value: Innermost region unresolved; atomic gas outside ALMA view

evidence.quote: The most interesting region for understanding the merger of V838 Mon remains unresolved but appears elongated.
Our observations therefore show us only the inner ($\sim$half) part of the gaseous remnant.

referee_caveats_inferred: Disk interpretation rests on a source barely larger than the beam (17.6x7.6 mas vs 22 mas beam).
Dust masses depend on arbitrary single-size opacity and no internal heating; extended-cloud mass may be overestimated.
No uncertainties on modeled dust masses or H2 mass.
Molecular mass relies on revised LTE models whose details are not shown.

reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA data and continuum/moment measurements are straightforward to redo, but imaging details are sparse and the mass results come from exploratory, non-unique RADMC-3D and inherited LTE models.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Project code given and data from 2019 cycle should be public; continuum component positions, sizes, fluxes and CO extent are numeric and reproducible with stated robust=0.5 Gaussian fits; modeling results are less reproducible.
